subject.title: feat(ui): approval UX overhaul — inline cards, fair queue, shortcuts, badges

question: Should maintainers sponsor this expanded Control UI approval interaction model, including inline authorization controls and keyboard decisions, after the remaining correctness fixes and real-runtime proof are supplied?
rationale: The patch introduces a broad new authorization UX rather than repairing a defined broken contract, and the protected maintainer label plus approval-security boundary require human acceptance of the permanent interaction model.

options.title: Sponsor and complete the approval UX
options.body: Require the two presentation fixes and redacted real Control UI proof, then review the sponsored interaction contract.

options.title: Narrow or decline the feature
options.body: Keep the existing modal workflow and request a smaller separately approved improvement if the broader inline and shortcut model is not desired.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and complete the approval UX
recommendation.body: Require the two presentation fixes and redacted real Control UI proof, then review the sponsored interaction contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current approval-UX implementation and are the clearest available routing point for the proposed interaction contract.
